criteria.requirement: Repair Traceback SyntaxError-derived capture to normalize msg, filename and source text through the existing safe_str helper, preserving actual original object fields and stable <exception str() failed> fallback. Actual Console rendering must survive numeric/container/custom messages instead of raising a second TypeError that hides the original problem. Preserve ordinary string diagnostics and offset/line positioning. Apply across the earlier accepted cyclic/shared exception graph without losing its identity bound; this delivery depends on that graph repair and does not re-count exception traversal as a separate phase.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
